name: Adriel
overview: Adriel is identified in Scripture primarily as the Meholathite who became the husband of Merab, Saul's daughter, instead of David (1 Samuel 18:19). He is also noted as the father of five sons whom Michal, another daughter of Saul, raised (2 Samuel 21:8). These sons were handed over by King David to the Gibeonites and were executed as part of a judgment during the barley harvest (2 Samuel 21:9). This account highlights Adriel's connection to Saul's family and the tragic consequences faced by his descendants in the aftermath of Saul's reign.
